name: List All General Ledger Details
description: Returns all General Ledger (GL) Details that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[DateFrom]
queryFilters.description: Start date for filtering GL details by transaction date. Required unless both LastUpdatedOnFrom and LastUpdatedOnTo are provided with a time range of 2 days or less.

queryFilters.name: filters[DateTo]
queryFilters.description: End date for filtering GL details by transaction date. Required unless both LastUpdatedOnFrom and LastUpdatedOnTo are provided with a time range of 2 days or less.

queryFilters.name: filters[PropertyId]
queryFilters.description: Unique identifier(s) of the property to filter by. Required unless both LastUpdatedOnFrom and LastUpdatedOnTo are provided and the time range between them is 2 days or less. Accepts comma-separated values.

queryFilters.name: filters[GlAccountId]
queryFilters.description: Unique identifier of the GL account to filter by.

queryFilters.name: filters[AccountingBasis]
queryFilters.description: The accounting basis to filter by (e.g. Cash or Accrual).

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedOnFrom]
queryFilters.description: Start of the last-updated range. When provided together with LastUpdatedOnTo with a range of 2 days or less, PropertyId is not required.

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedOnTo]
queryFilters.description: End of the last-updated range. When provided together with LastUpdatedOnFrom with a range of 2 days or less, PropertyId is not required.

queryFilters.name: page[number]
queryFilters.description: Page number to retrieve. Default is 1.

queryFilters.name: page[size]
queryFilters.description: Number of results per page. Default is 1000.

responseFields.name: data[].LineItemId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the line item associated to this GL detail

responseFields.name: data[].GlAccountId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the GL account

responseFields.name: data[].PropertyId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the property associated with the GL transaction

responseFields.name: data[].UnitId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the unit associated with the GL transaction

responseFields.name: data[].Date
responseFields.description: The date of the transaction associated with the GL transaction

responseFields.name: data[].Reference
responseFields.description: The reference number of the transaction associated with the GL transaction

responseFields.name: data[].Remarks
responseFields.description: Remarks or notes pertaining to the GL transaction

responseFields.name: data[].Description
responseFields.description: A brief, informative message pertaining to the GL transaction

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
